cases.title: Verify initial hidden state of the text box
cases.description: Ensure the text box (data-testid='text-box') is initially hidden and does not have the 'show' class.

cases.title: Toggle text box visibility via toggle button click
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button') toggles the visibility of the text box by adding or removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Handle rapid repeated clicks on toggle button
cases.description: Verify that rapid repeated clicks on the 'Toggle Text Box' button are handled reliably and the final visibility state reflects the last user action without inconsistency.

analysis.analysis: For requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-1, multiple distinct behaviors are described, including initial hidden state, toggling via button click, addition and removal of the 'show' class, rapid repeated clicks, and boundary conditions. For requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-2, multiple behaviors are present such as initial hidden state, toggle button click making the box visible, close button visibility inside the text box, close button click hiding the text box, and class manipulation. For requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-3, multiple behaviors include populating the dropdown after opening the text box, invoking getVoices via speechSynthesis.getVoices(), populating dropdown option elements with voice names and languages, listening for 'voiceschanged' events, and assigning selected voices to message.voice. For requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-4, multiple behaviors cover voice selection from the dropdown, setting the chosen voice for speech synthesis, population upon page load, handling multiple selections, and supporting specific language codes like 'CN' or 'US'. For requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-5, multiple behaviors include entering text into the textarea, reading it aloud using the selected voice, toggling the text box, and clicking the 'Read Text' button. For requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-6, multiple behaviors include dynamic generation of predefined phrase boxes from a data array, rendering images and paragraphs, clicking a box to read text via Web Speech API, visual highlighting using the active class for 800 milliseconds, and handling normal, sequential, and rapid repeated clicks.
